paper_id: Detecting Code Clones with Graph Neural Networkand Flow-Augmented Abstract Syntax Tree
title: Detecting Code Clones with Graph Neural Network and Flow-Augmented Abstract Syntax Tree
motivation: 现有AST方法缺乏控制流和数据流等语义信息,导致语义克隆(Type-4)检测效果差
problem_framing: 将代码对相似度检测建模为学习从代码片段到特征向量的映射函数,使得预测相似度与真实标签接近
key_insight: FA-AST在AST基础上显式添加控制流和数据流边,让GNN同时捕获语法结构和语义信息
method_signature: FA-AST构建加边+GNN消息传递+余弦相似度
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 现有数据集不够难,当前深度学习模型在此类数据集上已接近饱和
evidence_for_taste: AST can reflect the rich structural information for program syntax
it does not contain some semantic information such as control flow
GGNN cannot effectively distinguish dissimilar code fragments
some widely-used code clone datasets are not difficult enough to test the power of current deep learning models
ASTNN cannot capture the similarity between them
thinking_moves: 不选AST也不选CFG,而是提出FA-AST融合两者
把AST加边问题拆解为5种语法边+3种控制流边,逐类说明必要性
区分GGNN和GMN:GMN通过cross-graph attention建模两个图之间的交互,GGNN分别独立编码
指出ASTNN等方法丢失结构信息的具体方式(转为二叉树/深度遍历拆分)
承认数据集局限性:现有数据集规模/复杂度不足以真正挑战模型能力
extraction_notes: 作者Zhi Jin为合作作者角色,论文为arXiv预印本,venue信息缺失故填null
